the paradise where Enoch and Elijah live worthily resplendent in dove-like
purity and in old age. O merciful Lord, have mercy upon the souls of ours who
have fallen asleep.
PRS. Hokvotsûn hankootsélots Krisdos Asdvadz ara hankisd yév
voghormootyoon, yév méz méghavoratsûs shnorhya ûztoghootyoon
hantsanats.
PRS. O Christ God, grant rest and mercy to the souls of those who are at rest;
and to us, sinners, grant forgiveness of our transgressions.
DCN. Yév yévûs khaghaghootyan ûzDér aghachéstsook.
Vasn hankootsyal hokvotsn aghachéstsook, ûzpûrgichûn mér Krisdos, zi
ûznosa ûnt artarsûn taséstsé, yév ûzméz gétsoostsé shnorhiv voghormootyan
yooro. Aménagal Dér Asdvadz mér, gétso yév voghormya.
DCN. And again let us beseech the Lord.
For the souls who are at rest, let us beseech Christ our Savior, that he may
rank them with the righteous and save us by his mercy. Almighty Lord, our
God, save us and have mercy upon us.
CLB. Dér voghormya,
Krisdos Vorti Asdoodzo anokhagal yév parékoot, kûta ko ararchagan sirovût i
hokis hankootsyal dzarayits kots. Hishya havoor médzi kalûsdyan arkayootyan
ko, ara arzhani voghormootyan, kavootyan yév toghootyan méghats.
CLB. Lord, have mercy, Lord, have mercy, Lord, have mercy.
O Christ, Son of God, forebearing and compassionate, have mercy through
your love as Creator upon the souls of your servants who are at rest.
Remember them on the great day when you come with your kingdom. Make
them worthy of mercy, expiation, and forgiveness of sins.
CLB. Tasavoryal baydzaratso ûnt soorpûs ko hachagoghmyan tasoon. Zi too
yés Dér yév ararich aménétsoon, tadavor géntanyats yév mérélots. Yév kéz
vayélé park, ishkhanootyoon yév badiv, ayzhm yév mishd yév havidyanûs
havidénits. Amén.
CLB. Rank and glorify them among the saints at your right hand, for you are
Lord and the Creator of all, the judge of the living and of the dead. And to you
is befitting glory, dominion, and honor, now and always and forever and ever.
phonetic.36:
PRS. Orhynal Dér mér Hisoos Krisdos. Amén.
CHR. Hayr mér vor hérgins és, soorp yéghitsi anoon ko. Yégéstsé
arkayootyoon ko. Yéghitsin gamk ko vorbés hérgins yév hérgri. Zhats mér
hanabazort door méz aysor.
PRS. Blessed be our Lord, Jesus Christ. Amen.
CHR. Our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom
come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily
bread.
CHR. Togh méz ûzbardis mér, vorbés yév mék toghoomk mérots bardabanats.
Yév mi danir zméz i portsootyoon, ayl pûrgya i charé.
PRS. Zi ko yé arkayootyoon yév zorootyoon yév park havidyans. Amén.
CHR. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against
CHR. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.
PRS. For Thine is the kingdom and the power and the glory forever. Amen.
CHR. Orhnétsits ûzDér haménayn zham, haménayn zham, orhootyoon nora i
péram im.
CLB.  Orhnyalk yéghérook i shnorhats Sûrpo Hokvooyn, yértayk
khaghaghootyamp, yév Dér yéghitsi ûnt tséz, ûnt aménésyanût. Amén.
CHR. I will bless the Lord at all times, his praise shall continually be in my
mouth.
CLB.  Be blessed by the grace of the Holy Spirit; depart in peace, and may
the Lord be with you all. Amen.

english.3:
ACL. Aghaghagétsék ar Dér aménayn yérgir, dzarayétsék Dyarn
oorakhootyamp.
Mûdék arachi nora tsûndzootyamp, dzanérook zi na é Dér Asdvadz mér.
ACL. Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth; worship the Lord with
gladness.
Come into his presence with singing; know that the Lord is God.
ACL. Na arar ûzméz, yév voch mék éyak, mék zhoghovoortk yév khashn
arodi nora.
Mûdék ûnt troonûs nora khosdovanootyamp, yév orhnootyamp i hargûs nora.
ACL. It is he that made us, and we are his; we are his people, and the sheep of
his pasture.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with praise.
ACL. Khosdovan yéghérook Dyarn, yév orhnétsék zanoon nora.
Kaghtsûr é Dér, havidyan é voghormootyoon nora, azké minchév hazk é
jûshmardootyoon nora.
ACL. Give thanks to him, bless his name.
For the Lord is good; his steadfast love endures forever, and his faithfulness to
all generations.
ACL. Park Hor yév Vortvo yév Hokvooyn Sûrpo.
Ayzhm yév mishd yév havidyanûs havidénits. Amén.
ACL. Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit.
Now and always and forever and ever. Amen.
